title: Akiyama Mizuki — Happy Birthday!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <It's your birthday tomorrow, right, Mizuki? I wanna celebrate, so mind coming to school for me tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just being at school makes me kinda tense, but there shouldn't be anything for me to worry about today...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Akiyama, happy birthday!
Mizuki! Happy birthday!
Happy birthday, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What a splendid reaction.
This surprise was well worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Akiyama, what are you doing standing over there?! Come join us!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold up, An, you said that you wanted to celebrate my birthday, right? You didn't mention anything about inviting Rui and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? It's your special day. There's no way I wasn't gonna invite them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I had everyone that was free join us here! Oh, but Akito's sister was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She said she'd pass since you already celebrated with your music group. She's probably sound asleep at home right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Right as we were about to call it a night, she had that look of satisfaction on her face after “pulling out all the stops” for her surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Mizuki, would you mind putting this on?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
A sash that says...? “Today's star”...?
Haha! You actually brought one of these?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It looks just right on you, Akiyama! As it should on today's star!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Even so, is that something to be happy about...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Do we get to watch a movie or something?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Better.
We had Kohane whip a little something together for us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Hehe. It's us! MORE MORE JUMP!
You've been such a loyal fan, so we'd like to sing a song for you to celebrate your birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <We hope you and your friends all enjoy as you listen.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Ready, Mizuki...?
We're gonna make this feel like the best day ever just for you!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Th-This is so awesome...!
MMJ's singing a song just for me?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is this really happening? Am I worthy of such an incredible gift?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, don't worry about that. Shizuku and Airi both said that they'd be more than delighted to do this for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori and Haruka also said the same thing. I'll send the video over to you later, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!!
You really are an angel, Kohane!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? But you don't get to have her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They certainly seem to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I have all of you to thank.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, a little surprise from us!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, Tsukasa, you guys prepared something too?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! You didn't expect us to come to a birthday party empty-handed, did you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we're going to sing! Rui, Toya, Akito! Let's start with the happy birthday song!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we'll cap things off by taking a commemorative photo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naturally, Akiyama, you'll be in the center!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should probably stand in the back.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, us too.
It'll probably look more balanced if we have An and Kohane in the front.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll stand wherever.
Stars need not choose where to stand! They will shine regardless!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I never really had many good memories when it came to school...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that looks great!
Nice work, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to see as well to make sure I actually smiled.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is that why you were touching your face so much before the shutter went off just now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I did. It was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki!
We heard that you really enjoyed our video letter!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm really glad we asked Minori and Haruka to do that for us. We should all go out together again sometime, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It might be fun to visit another mountain and soak in some nice views. Anyway, we'll let you know if anything comes up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm very happy with how your birthday party went, Akiyama. Not only was it fun, you had a great, big smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I wasn't sure what to give you for your birthday because I didn't know what you like... But I'm glad we were able to present you with something nice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Akiyama definitely seemed happy, but at my expense.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? According to Shiraishi, you were okay with it as long as Aoyagi here was on board.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. There's no need to be shy, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he tends to act like this in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, settle down. Next, it's our turn. Once again, Mizuki, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hope we get to stay friends for as long as possible! I mean, it's not every day that you meet someone you can connect with so well!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I'd like it if we got to know each other a little better, so let's talk again sometime. Once again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
Thank you for always making such incredible music videos for us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also need to thank you for really watching out for us. You've helped us all out so many times that I've lost count. Looking forward to keep working with you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday...
I can't actually tell, but I'm guessing this means quite a lot to you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At least, that's what it seemed like when we celebrated in SEKAI... Anyway, I'll see you later on Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Mizuki.
Did you have fun during the party at school? I guess I could just ask Akito about how it went...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it seems better to ask you personally, so let me know what it was like sometime. I'll be waiting on Nightcord! See you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Today was such an amazing day.
And I have all of you to thank.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really need to thank Ena and the others.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But...
It might be nice to spend a day like this every so often.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, today is my birthday after all♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really appreciate how you all joined me to celebrate.
